# Product-Qualified Active Accounts

## Description

Accounts showing real product usage, surfaced to sales as a product-qualified-lead draft with a ready-to-send plan email drafted.

## Steps

### Step 1: Build the active account list

Build a new segment named PQL: Active Accounts. An account is in the segment only when the users in the account together did session start event 3 or more times in the last 14 d.

### Step 2: Draft a sales alert

Generate a Slack message to sales channel. For each account in the segment from "Build the active account list", name the account so reps can reach out to this product-qualified lead while usage is fresh. Use the result of "Build the active account list". This drafts the Slack message only; a person on the team still posts it. Take the names or addresses from the member list of the step that built the segment (at most 20, then how many more); never write a placeholder or ask the reader to paste anything in. If no member list is available, name the segment and say it can be opened in Segments.

### Step 3: Draft a plan email

Generate a designed marketing email for the accounts in the segment from "Build the active account list" showing what the team gets from a plan that fits how much they use the product. Write 3 sentences in a confident and helpful tone with no discount language, and include one button linking to pricing page. Use the result of "Build the active account list". This drafts the email only; a person still sends it. If the brand kit has no logo, use the brand name as a plain text header; the button links to the URL chosen for this run.
